query:
The group regularly does a shared meal before dark-sky sessions — Cecilia organises these and they seem like part of the tradition. Does this actually apply to all members? If not, who opts out and how does the chat show this?

Options:
A. Jerome
B. Tomás
C. Ruth
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:36:00) ok back to Feb 17th logistics, do we want to do the group meal first or go straight to site? I was thinking Thai takeaway at mine at 6:30 then car share to Blackmoor by 8? 🍜🌟
[2] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[3] (about=Harriet, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:40:00) I want to do an episode built around that weekend. The group, the dark sky, the contrast between people seeing it for the first time and veterans like Nadia who have been chasing this for thirty years. Dev, your reaction on the night would be perfect audio.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:38:00) dev and I stayed up till 3am watching jupiter and saturn transit. the seeing came up to 4/5 around 1am and at 400x on jupiter you could see three festoons in the NEB simultaneously. that's the best planetary night I've had in two years
[5] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:31:00) I have been saying this since session one. In my experience there is no substitute for genuine darkness. The Milky Way shadow phenomenon happens around SQM 22.0 or above. You cannot replicate it closer to town, full stop.
[6] (about=Ruth, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:44:00) In favour. Though I would note that for a pure double-star session on a steady night, Blackmoor is still adequate. Seeing matters more than darkness for splitting tight pairs.
